paper.title_en: Boltzmann Dynamics in K-essence Cosmology: Photon Propagation in an Emergent Spacetime
paper.abstract_en: Recent cosmological tensions, notably the Hubble and $S_{8}$ tensions, motivate extensions of the conventional FLRW framework in which additional dynamical fields can alter the effective spacetime experienced by matter and radiation. In K-essence cosmology, the scalar field induces an emergent FLRW geometry disformally related to the gravitational metric, leading to a \emph{tilted causal structure} in which the photon light cone differs from that of gravity. We develop a covariant Boltzmann formalism in a homogeneous K-essence background and derive the modified mass-shell condition, geodesic equations, and collision integrals for both massless and massive species. The photon distribution remains thermal in the emergent frame, while appearing geometrically rescaled in the gravitational frame. Microphysical Thomson/Compton scattering is unmodified; instead, the emergent geometry induces effective rest-frame energies and a geometrically rescaled scattering rate, conveniently encoded in a transport coefficient $σ_T^{(\mathrm{geom})}$. Focusing on the tightly coupled pre-recombination era, we obtain modified acoustic dynamics and, for a purely kinetic DBI-type model, find an effective interaction rate scaling $n_{e}σ_T^{(\mathrm{geom})}a\propto a^{-8}$ and a diffusion scale scaling $k_{D}^{-2}\propto a^{29/2}$, enhancing the sensitivity of small-scale anisotropies to the evolving geometry. Our results provide a self-consistent kinetic description of particle transport in the emergent K-essence spacetime, and they lay the groundwork for a full numerical Einstein-Boltzmann implementation to compute post-recombination free streaming and the CMB angular power spectrum. A detailed numerical analysis will be pursued in future work.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文在K-essence宇宙学中构建了协变Boltzmann形式体系，推导了修正的质壳条件、测地线方程与碰撞积分，并给出了紧耦合复合前时期的修正声学动力学与标度关系，属于对引力理论基础与因果结构的深度理论探讨，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: K-essence宇宙学中的Boltzmann动力学：涌现时空中的光子传播
decision.abstract_zh: 近期的宇宙学张力，尤其是Hubble张力和$S_{8}$张力，促使人们扩展传统FLRW框架，在该框架中额外动力学场可以改变物质与辐射所感受到的有效时空。在K-essence宇宙学中，标量场诱导出一个涌现的FLRW几何，该几何与引力度规通过非度量（disformal）方式相关联，导致一种\emph{倾斜的因果结构}，其中光子光锥不同于引力的光锥。我们在均匀K-essence背景中发展了协变Boltzmann形式体系，并推导了无质量粒子和有质量粒子的修正质壳条件、测地线方程与碰撞积分。光子分布在涌现标架中保持热分布，而在引力标架中表现为几何重标度。微观Thomson/Compton散射未被修改；相反，涌现几何诱导出有效静止系能量以及几何重标度的散射率，这可以方便地编码在一个输运系数$σ_T^{(\mathrm{geom})}$中。聚焦于紧耦合的复合前时期，我们得到了修正的声学动力学，并且对于纯动能的DBI型模型，发现有效相互作用率标度为$n_{e}σ_T^{(\mathrm{geom})}a\propto a^{-8}$，扩散尺度标度为$k_{D}^{-2}\propto a^{29/2}$，从而增强了小尺度各向异性对演化几何的敏感性。我们的结果为涌现K-essence时空中的粒子输运提供了一个自洽的动理学描述，并且为完整的数值Einstein-Boltzmann实现奠定了基础，以计算复合后的自由流和CMB角功率谱。详细的数值分析将在未来工作中进行。
